capabilities: Open a random unstarted prompt as a new note
Resume a random prompt already started in a note
Browse all prompts in a fuzzy-searchable list
Add prompts from the command palette with duplicate detection
Configure prompts file, output folder, and note template
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, per its manifest description.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a list of writing prompts and jump into a random one as a note to write in.
summary: Random writing prompt manager that stores a prompt list in one Markdown file and opens a random prompt as a new or existing note.
